public_facts.start_pose: The single arm you control starts raised at its Ready pose with the gripper open.
public_facts.scene: A tabletop within the single arm's reach. X is forward from the arm base, Y is left, Z is up. The arm reaches roughly x 0.15 to 0.55 at grasp height. Change pitch in steps of at most 12 degrees; no joint may move more than 35 degrees per command.
public_facts.camera_notes: This run uses one fixed camera looking across the table from the front; both returned images are that view. Objects and the arm are visible in it.
